description.value: FSJ Community Garden is a publicly accessible community garden in Fort Saint John in Northern BC. Community gardens in this region offer touring cyclists a quiet green space to rest and connect with local growing culture. The garden has hosted public events including a garden tour, suggesting it is an active community asset.

address.value: 9803 87 St, Fort St John, BC V1J 4Y6, Canada
